description: This file defines a handler class for processing 'calculate interest' commands on savings accounts within the Apache Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface, uses dependency injection for the savings account service, and executes interest calculation logic within a transactional context.

classes.name: CalculateInterestSavingsAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles calculation of interest for savings accounts when a corresponding command is received. It delegates the operation to the savings account write platform service.

methods.name: CalculateInterestSavingsAccountCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the savings account write platform service dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to calculate interest by invoking the savings account service method within a transactional context.
